pure-announcement.rationale: It is a docs welcome/navigation page rather than a launch, release note, or funding announcement, and it does define transferable notions like context augmentation and workflows, however thinly.

duplicate.rationale: The existing RAG concept covers this page's one conceptual nugget (context augmentation via retrieval), but the page's actual subject — the LlamaIndex framework and its ecosystem — is not covered by any nearest concept.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Its checkable content (APIs, quickstart code, package names) is verifiable against the linked repos and docs; only puffery like 'world's best document parser' is unverifiable.

durability.rationale: The bulk is a vendor feature matrix and navigation index — LlamaCloud plans, 10,000 free monthly credits, ecosystem project lists — that churns with every docs reorg, leaving only one-paragraph definitions of RAG-adjacent terms as stable content.

actionability.rationale: Its only concrete guidance is product-bound setup (pip install llama-index, the 5-line quickstart, sign up for LlamaCloud), which informs adoption of this vendor but not how to build or decide in general.

atomicity.rationale: It is a grab-bag hub — agents, workflows, context augmentation, cloud services, community, ecosystem — where no single idea is developed beyond a teaser paragraph, so there is no one stateable core and nothing meaty enough to split out.
